Join ADAMA – A Global Leader in Crop Protection shaping the future of agriculture. With nearly 8,500 employees and $4 billion in annual sales across more than 100 countries, ADAMA is one of the world’s top crop protection companies and part of the Syngenta Group. Our mission is to create simplicity in agriculture – helping farmers grow. We are proud to foster a diverse and inclusive workplace and welcome candidates from all backgrounds. At ADAMA, we are focused on creating simplicity in agriculture – helping farmers grow. We are looking for a Marketing Campaign Lead to join our Italy team and help turn our commercial strategy into impactful, customer-focused campaigns. This role sits at the heart of Sales and Marketing, driving campaign excellence, supporting new product launches and ensuring our teams are aligned and ready to deliver in the market. What You Will Do Plan and coordinate commercial campaigns and territory action plans, ensuring activities are aligned with market needs, buying cycles and application windows. Support New Product Introduction (NPI) activities, from pre-launch preparation through to launch and product adoption. Equip sales teams with the insights, tools and information they need to execute campaigns and launches effectively. Use customer, market and sales insights to identify high-potential opportunities and improve campaign ROI. Monitor market developments, customer needs and trends to help shape effective commercial action plans. Work closely with Crop Managers, Area Managers, Field Marketing and Sales teams to ensure strong execution across Italy. Track campaign performance against key KPIs, including market share, product usage, awareness and commercial performance. Support the delivery of Italy's growth strategy and monitor ROI against campaign targets. Build strong relationships with distributors, channel partners and key external stakeholders. What You Will Bring At least 3 years' experience in Sales and/or Marketing within the agricultural sector, ideally including Product Management or Crop Management experience. A degree in Agriculture or a related field. Strong knowledge of agronomy, crop protection and commercial/customer insights. A customer-focused, value-selling mindset with strong commercial awareness. Excellent planning, organisational and analytical skills. The ability to manage complexity, solve problems and turn insights into action. Strong communication and influencing skills, with confidence engaging internal and external stakeholders. A collaborative, adaptable and results-oriented approach. Fluent Italian and business-level English. Strong Microsoft Office skills. Willingness to travel up to 50%. Why join ADAMA? This is an exciting opportunity to play a key role in commercialising products, accelerating new product adoption and delivering growth across the Italian market. You'll work closely with Sales, Marketing and Field teams, gaining broad exposure to the business while directly influencing how ADAMA brings products and campaigns to customers. Join ADAMA and help us create simplicity in agriculture. You’re a strategic, commercially minded marketing leader who can connect European priorities with what matters locally. You bring teams, partners and channels together around clear plans, translating customer and market insight into relevant marketing that builds the brand and drives growth. The opportunity As Marketing Lead for Italy, you’ll have end-to-end accountability for the strategy, planning, prioritisation and delivery of marketing activity across one of easyJet’s most important European markets. Reporting to the Head of European Marketing, you’ll work closely with commercial, trading, CRM, media, PR and agency partners to translate European brand and business priorities into locally relevant plans that build consideration, demand and commercial performance. You’ll lead the local team and remain accountable for market investment, performance and results, while shaping how easyJet shows up for customers across Italy. “We’re looking for someone who combines strategic thinking with strong commercial judgement and hands-on leadership. You’ll bring a clear point of view on the Italian market, give the team direction and bring partners together around marketing that is locally relevant and makes a measurable difference.” The team & culture You’ll join one European marketing function, working closely with central marketing teams, commercial stakeholders, local market experts and creative and media agencies. The environment is collaborative, insight-led and commercially focused. You’ll lead the local marketing team, creating clarity, building capability and helping people do their best work. What You’ll Be Doing You’ll set the Italy market strategy and turn European priorities, local opportunities and trading needs into a focused, integrated marketing plan across paid, owned and partner channels. You’ll make disciplined choices about budgets and resources, working with media, CRM, web merchandising, PR and trading teams to improve relevance, conversion and return. You’ll champion locally relevant creative and storytelling, bringing Italian customer, competitor and cultural insight into campaign development and ensuring our marketing resonates locally while remaining consistent with the easyJet brand. You’ll build productive relationships with agencies, tourist boards, airports and other key partners, using performance evidence to adapt priorities and investment. As a people leader, you’ll provide clear direction, coach and develop your team, delegate effectively and build capability while delivering high-quality work at pace. What We’re Looking For You’ll bring broad senior marketing experience, ideally gained with consumer brands in fast-paced, commercially driven environments. You know how to translate organisational priorities into a clear market vision and integrated plans. You combine strong commercial judgement with analytical capability. You can manage budgets and forecasts, interpret performance, make sound investment decisions and explain your recommendations clearly to senior stakeholders. You’re experienced across paid, owned and partner channels, confident leading agencies and external suppliers, and skilled in campaign briefing, creative evaluation and measurement. Just as importantly, you’re an inclusive and resilient leader who builds trusted relationships, stays decisive when information is incomplete and turns local customer, competitor and cultural insight into action. This is an opportunity to work at the intersection of sport, entertainment and betting , developing creative campaigns that reach passionate sports audiences. The Role As Marketing Manager , you'll be responsible for planning and executing marketing activity across DAZN-owned platforms, paid media and sports club partnerships. You'll work closely with the Marketing Director and wider DAZN teams to develop campaigns that strengthen brand awareness, increase consideration and drive customer acquisition and retention. From developing creative concepts and briefing designers through to managing campaign delivery and analysing performance, you'll take ownership of ensuring our marketing activity delivers measurable results. You'll also play a key role in shaping how DAZN Bet appears across TV, digital, social, CRM and editorial channels, ensuring a consistent brand experience while meeting relevant advertising and regulatory requirements. Strong experience managing marketing budgets, media planning and buying, with the ability to balance brand-building activity and performance-driven acquisition. A creative mindset with experience developing campaign concepts, writing compelling marketing copy and briefing internal designers or external agencies. Experience working with sports partnerships, clubs, creators, influencers or talent to develop engaging marketing content and campaigns. Lavoriamo tra musica, entertainment, food e sport: strategia, social, produzione foto e video, advertising ed eventi.
